item.title: Alex Borg says he proposed name for chief justice nomination but received no reply from PM
item.description: In letter sent to Prime Minister Robert Abela, Opposition leader Alex Borg says he already made it clear during their last private meeting there would be no agreement on the name put forward by the PM, and during that same meeting he proposed the name of another individual as a possible alternative but received no reply

item.title: Amicable deal ends Lidl–CBC row over Żebbuġ project
item.description: The settlement resolves a dispute tied to construction obligations linked to the redevelopment of the former woodworks factory

item.title: Gozo Channel hit by cyber attack, ferry operations not affected
item.description: The cyber incident disrupted internal IT systems but was contained without interrupting the ferry service

item.title: Labour accuses PN of stalling chief justice appointment
item.description: Government says Opposition leader Alex Borg is blocking vote on Judge Consuelo Scerri Herrera's nomination to protect party interests

item.title: Metsola calls for a relations reset between Europe and the United Kingdom
item.description: European Parliament President Roberta Metsola says the EU and UK need new approaches of working together

item.title: Maltese duo arrested over online scam targeting 200 victims
item.description: Police say a 25-year-old woman posed as a local bank to scam around 200 victims, with the case linked to a cross-border network involving Ireland and the UK

item.title: PN approves new candidate for general election
item.description: Edmond Cuschieri will contest the election on the Nationalist Party ticket on the 8th district

item.title: Beating cancer is a test for Europe | David Casa, Tomislav Sokol
item.description: We remain committed to a Europe that protects through prevention, through innovation, and through fairness. The fight against cancer is not one we can afford to pause

item.title: Demolish now, sanction later: Carlo Stivala applies to regularise Sliema building demolition
item.description: Hotelier Carlo Stivala has submitted a new application to regularise the demolition of the façade of a Sliema building fronting Triq ix-Xatt and Triq San Vincenz, where a 15-storey hotel was approved last year

item.title: When transparency is a game of pick and choose
item.description: Discussions on such appointments should be held confidentially between the prime minister and the Opposition leader, with a modicum of respect towards each other and the suggested nominees
